Author: Saumitra Dayal Singh

High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Court No. - 64

Applicant :- Rajkumar And 3 Others

Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Jitendra Kumar
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Saumitra Dayal Singh,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicants and learned AGA for the State.

2. Present application has been filed to quash the summoning order dated 09.7.2015 and the proceedings of Complaint Case No. 557 of 2015 under Sections 498A, 323, 427, 452, 504, 506, 504 IPC and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Simbhawali, District Hapur, Pending in the Court of Judicial Magistrate, Court No. 2 Garhmukteshwar.

entities.text: Police Station Simbhawali, District Hapur, Pending
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 3. At the outset, learned counsel for parties states, though mediation has failed, during pendency of present proceedings, it has been stated, applicant No. 1 and opposite party No. 2 have been able to resolve their matrimonial discord such that the marriage between those parties has been dissolved.

Copy of the order passed by the Principal JudgeFamily Court, Hapur dated 14.9.2021 in Case No.
135 of 2021 has been filed together with the supplementary affidavit, filed today taken on record.

sentences.text: 4.Supplementary affidavit brings out existence of written settlement reached between the parties.

Occasioned by that the opposite party No. 2 had filed application dated 13.9.2021 before the learned Judicial Magistrate, Court No. 2 Garhmukteshwar in Criminal Complaint Case No. 557 of 2015 supported by her personal affidavit.
5.In view of such facts brought on record, it does appear that the parties have settled their dispute outside Court such that no dispute survives.

6. In such circumstances, though no useful purpose would be served in allowing the prosecution to continue any further, however, no firm conclusion may be reached, at this stage, as to complete falsity of the allegations made against the applicants.
The present 482 Cr.P.C. application thus stands allowed.

7. The summoning order dated 09.7.2015 and the proceedings of Complaint Case No. 557 of 2015 under Sections 498A, 323, 427, 452, 504, 506, 504 IPC and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Simbhawali, District Hapur, Pending in the Court of Judicial Magistrate, Court No. 2 Garhmukteshwar are quashed insofar as it relates to applicants.
